name: Hospitality
description: Support and celebrate teachers and staff through conference dinners, holiday treats, and other appreciation activities.

name: Cultural Arts
description: Help bring enriching experiences to students through school assemblies, International Night, and cultural programming.

name: Fundraising
description: Help organize fundraising initiatives such as restaurant nights, spirit wear, Fun Run, Holiday Market, and Parent's Night Out.

name: Grants & Awards
description: Identify and pursue grants and donations that provide additional resources and opportunities for students and staff.

name: Technology
description: Support the PTA website and digital platforms, provide technology assistance, and help strengthen the PTA's online presence.

name: Communications & Membership
description: Help keep Thunder Hill families informed, promote PTA activities, and encourage community participation and PTA membership.

name: Budget
description: Help develop the PTA's annual budget and determine how PTA funds can best support the school community.

name: Events
description: Help plan and coordinate memorable events for Thunder Hill students, families, and staff.

name: After-School Programs
description: Help coordinate enriching extracurricular and after-school opportunities for Thunder Hill students.

name: 5th Grade
description: Help make the final elementary-school year special through activities such as signs, shirts, the 5th-grade picnic, and Battle of the Books.
